explication: GenOffice is a desktop AI office suite for editing Office files, PDF, Markdown, and HTML, with a command-line/MCP interface for agents. A typical user opens a file in the shell, edits it in a format-specific app—with AI assistance available—and saves it back in its native format. The README also documents local conversion, file search, and slide generation. The supplied tree and excerpts support the shell-to-app wiring and several app entry points, but not detailed wiring for every capability; those links are intentionally limited.
